verdict.rationale: An app marketplace is a fair question for a Git forge, but the evidence shows no marketplace or app directory for installing third-party integrations. The pack documents only specific built-in integrations (GitHub sync, Buildkite CI) and developer building blocks (webhooks, REST API, personal access tokens, MCP server). None of these is an installable-integration directory.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install third-party integrations from a marketplace or app directory
